import urllib.request, re
from urllib.parse import urljoin
base='http://127.0.0.1:5173/'
seen=set(); bad=[]; q=['/resources/js/app.ts','/resources/js/pages/MainPage.vue']
while q:
    p=q.pop()
    if p in seen: continue
    seen.add(p)
    try:
        r=urllib.request.urlopen(base+p.lstrip('/'),timeout=30)
        code=r.status; body=r.read().decode('utf-8','ignore')
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        bad.append((p,e.code)); continue
    except Exception as e:
        bad.append((p,str(e))); continue
    if code!=200:
        bad.append((p,code)); continue
    # imports referencing local paths
    for m in re.findall(r'from\s*"([^"]+)"', body):
        if m.startswith('/') and not m.startswith('/@vite'):
            if '/node_modules/.vite/deps' in m: continue
            if m.endswith('.vue') or m.endswith('.ts') or m.endswith('.js') or '/ui/' in m:
                q.append(m)
print("modules fetched:",len(seen))
print("broken:",bad)
EOF
